GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 12 Lengths Drifted Back Settled Down 6th 3 Wide 8 Lengths off leader/winner Out On A Limb had no favours but Couldn'T Go On x 600m - # 3 Wide struggled

Jumped Ok Restrained Took sit Settled Down 5th 5 Lengths Hooked Out 3 Wide x 600m lay in Straightening Up Kept Finding under riding , hit Lead @ 50m 2 Horse War to line (stablemate was fav, finished 3rd) # just too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped. Laid in during the early stages of the home straight. Shifted in and brushed near the 50m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 4th Outside 5 Lengths enjoyed good trail To The Turn into 2nd Soon After Straightening Up Joined in x 100m - 1st was 3 Wide throughout and Out On A Limb this had its chance ! - # had all favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mount was inclined to lay in throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly . Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Stayed Mid Field Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 550m. Pushed along Four Wide @ 450m & chasing Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & laid in but ran on soundly in last 200m. blinkers off / winkers first time. # Laid in/OK late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 1400m, steadied from the heels of a riderless runner. Laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Raced keenly Worse than midfield Two Wide (6L from lead) early . Stayed same until improving 3 Wide from 1100m to race narrow 2nd Two Wide @ 900m. Stayed 2nd Two Wide until pushed to quicken 3 Wide (1/2L from lead) on home turn. Challenged leader & pressured @ 300m. Headed @ 200m & stuck to task well late. Blinkers First Time # Early move/good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Over-raced through the early stages. Passing the 1000m was taken wider and proceeded forward to settle outside the lead.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok bustled, sat back 6l off, improved turn ridden along , Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, half off 100m, kept on strong, no match winner # found 1 better
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported it had been his intention to settle in a forward position, however after the gelding was only fairly away and despite being ridden along, it failed to muster speed from the barriers, as a result, was obliged to settle at the rear of the field.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off all clear, half off 100m and kept on strong to the line # found 1 better

Jumped fairly. Pushed fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & only held ground in last 200m. # One-paced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding her riding rounding the home turn, apprentice stated whilst under riding from the 500m, her mount began to hang, and she was unaware of how far she had shifted until straightening in the home straight. Rdr further added that in hindsight, she should have made greater efforts to straighten her mount when in began shifting ground. Stewards agreed with in that she should have made greater efforts to straighten her mount and further advised that she must ride her mounts in a manner that leaves no query.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat handy 1 length off 3 Wide No Cover , improved to join lead turn, Straightened Up joint lead, soon headed and dropped out # 3 Wide worked
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start by rnr. Raced wide and without cover in the early stages until allowed to stride forward to attain a position outside the lead near the 700m.

Hampered shortly after the start. Raced ungenerously in the early and middle stages of the event shifted ground when placed under pressure in the straight. Rider reported mount which was having its first race start would derive benefit form the experience.
